# `tfctl api schema get`

The `tfctl api schema get` command shows a trimmed OpenAPI document for a single operation or all operations on an exact API path.

## Usage

```shell-session
$ tfctl api schema get OPERATION_ID_OR_PATH [options]
```

## Description

The `tfctl api schema get` command displays the OpenAPI schema for a specific API operation or path. You can provide either an operation ID (like `getWorkspace`) or an exact API path (like `/organizations/{organization}/workspaces`).

When you provide an operation ID, the command shows the schema for that specific operation. When you provide a path, it shows all operations available on that path. Paths can include path parameters denoted with curly braces, for example `{organization}` or `{workspace_id}`.

## Arguments

- `OPERATION_ID_OR_PATH`: (Required) An exact OpenAPI operation ID or an API path starting with `/` to inspect.

## Available options

The `tfctl api schema get` command does not support any command-specific options.

### Global flags

Refer to [Global flags reference](/terraform/tfctl-cli/reference/cli#global-flags) for information about flags you can use with all commands.

## Output

The command outputs a trimmed [OpenAPI document in JSON format](https://learn.openapis.org/specification/structure) that includes details about the operation, request parameters, request body schema if applicable, and response schemas.

## Examples

The following examples demonstrate how to get OpenAPI schema for operations by path and operation ID.

### Inspect the getWorkspaces operation by operation ID

The following example prints the OpenAPI schema for the `getWorkspace` operation.

```shell-session
$ tfctl api schema get getWorkspace
```

### Inspect the getWorkspaces operation by path

The following example prints the OpenAPI schema for the `getWorkspace` operation by referencing its path.

```shell-session
$ tfctl api schema get /workspaces/{workspace_id}
```

### Show all operations on a path

The following example prints the OpenAPI schema for operations on workspaces.

```shell-session
$ tfctl api schema get /organizations/{organization}/workspaces
```
